original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Correct the full-target coverage screen, test the exact physical interstage frames and complete idle invoice, and test a paired-endpoint E8 complex-structure rotation with literal terminal closure.
scope_change_reason: The inherited local-only probe kept the old coverage law after enlarging target endpoints. This continuation corrects that applicability error and tests a different source/target endpoint pair. The explicit user objective remains a verified kappa above 0.002.
bottleneck_link: False-positive scalar and moment evidence must be removed before pursuing a real supplier. The fixed FULL/FULL schedule has negative rank deficit; a rotating source/target pair preserves local mass but its literal address closure uses the whole deficit.
stop_rule: Reject the fixed FULL/FULL geometry after the exact first-junction counterexample and complete profiles. Test one six-step rotating-normal coordinate-core walk, including its actual address endpoint and correction. Do not expand either construction on scalar checks alone.
evidence: RESULT.json, verify.py and boundary_audit.py retain the scalar controls and verify exact rational frame mismatches at 111 ports, complete 5/9/11-stage rank budgets, and the 120-root E8 normal rotation with exact six-step address-operator drift and literal repair invoice.
author: Gonzalo Mier
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in the construction, exact replay, checker integration and writing; no independent human review is implied.
